description: Header file defining the FrameRate class, which manages frame rate collection, configuration, and reporting within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for starting/stopping FPS collection, updating FPS values, handling frame rate changes, and interfacing with IARM event system.

classes.name: FrameRate
classes.description: A plugin class for managing frame rate collection, configuration, and reporting in the WPEFramework environment.

methods.description: Wrapper method to set the frame rate collection frequency based on JSON parameters.

methods.description: Wrapper method to start FPS collection based on JSON parameters.

methods.description: Wrapper method to stop FPS collection based on JSON parameters.
